stepBody: What is the probability of winning at least one prize in $$10$$ spins?##figure10.gif##

figureAlts.figure10.gif: A description and table related to a wheel-spinning game at a carnival, showing the true distribution of prizes. The table has two columns: Prize and Chance. Prize options are Nothing, Teddy bear, Pinwheel, and Sticker. Chance percentages are 90% for Nothing, 1% for Teddy bear, 3% for Pinwheel, and 6% for Sticker. The distribution is used to answer probability questions.
